entries.summary: Messages you queue while a response runs show as a chip above the composer instead of a notice; tap it to see them in full and send one now, edit it or remove it.
Long-press Send to queue, steer, stop and send, ask a side question or run the message in the background, without typing a slash command; the keyboard stays up while the menu is open.
A chevron beside + shows or hides the control strip under the composer, and the choice holds across chats.
